card.title: Nintendo Switch Console only charges from one side of the USB-C port Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Console only charges from one side of the USB-C port Repair

symptoms: charges from one cable orientation only

claims.statement: A Switch that charges from only one side of the USB-C plug points to the port, M92T36, PI3USB or diode packs; if the port is fine, change M92T36.

procedure: Replace M92T36 if the port is fine.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
